# Texuli

> Texuli is a Svelte 5 component system with a closed agent catalog and a sink-free renderer.

This file is generated from catalog manifests. Prefer component pages under `components/` for props and examples.

## Agent-emittable components

Ids agents may emit into a catalog tree (subject to tier rules). Untrusted model output is limited further by the catalog build tiers.

- [Action form](components/action-form.md): Groups fields whose submit proposes one named action intent to the host.
- [Code blocks](components/blocks-code.md): Validated, highlighted code.
- [Data blocks](components/blocks-data.md): Validated tables, statistics, key metrics and chart content blocks.
- [Diagram blocks](components/blocks-diagram.md): Validated flow, tree, board and terminal diagrams.
- [Embed blocks](components/blocks-embed.md): Validated link previews (URL policy) and embed-app shells. Texuli never runs app JSON; hosts mount via mountEmbed with a sandboxed iframe contract.
- [Interactive blocks](components/blocks-interactive.md): Validated polls, quizzes, calculators and checklists.
- [Map blocks](components/blocks-map.md): Validated map points and routes.
- [Media blocks](components/blocks-media.md): Validated image, figure, video and gallery content blocks.
- [Structure blocks](components/blocks-structure.md): Validated layouts and calls to action.
- [Text blocks](components/blocks-text.md): Validated heading, paragraph, list, quote and callout content.
- [Canvas](components/canvas.md): A whiteboard or diagram as data: shapes, sticky notes, text, frames, groups and connectors on an infinite canvas.
- [Area chart](components/charts-area.md): A categorical area chart with an accessible data table.
- [Bar chart](components/charts-bar.md): A categorical bar chart with a zero baseline and accessible data table.
- [Bubble chart](components/charts-bubble.md): A scatter plot where point size can encode another measure.
- [Bullet chart](components/charts-bullet.md): A compact value, range and target comparison.
- [Canvas chart renderer](components/charts-canvas-renderer.md): A low-level canvas mark renderer for dense chart series.
- [Cartesian chart](components/charts-cartesian.md): The general line, area, bar, stacked bar or combo chart renderer.
- [Combo chart](components/charts-combo.md): A categorical chart that combines bar and line series.
- [Donut chart](components/charts-donut.md): A part-to-whole chart with a central opening and data table.
- [Funnel chart](components/charts-funnel.md): A conversion funnel with step values and accessible table.
- [Gauge chart](components/charts-gauge.md): A radial value gauge with thresholds and an accessible data table.
- [Geographic map](components/charts-geo-map.md): A tiled geographic choropleth with a tabular data alternative.
- [Geographic point map](components/charts-geo-point-map.md): Geographic points positioned on a tiled map.
- [Heatmap](components/charts-heatmap.md): A matrix of labeled cells with an accessible data table.
- [Line chart](components/charts-line.md): A categorical line chart with accessible values.
- [Network graph](components/charts-network.md): A node and connection graph with an accessible table.
- [Pie chart](components/charts-pie.md): A part-to-whole chart with an accessible data table.
- [Progress ring](components/charts-progress-ring.md): A compact radial progress indicator with a data table.
- [Sankey chart](components/charts-sankey.md): A weighted flow diagram with an accessible table.
- [Scatter chart](components/charts-scatter.md): A quantitative scatter plot with an accessible data table.
- [Sparkline](components/charts-sparkline.md): A compact line, area or bar trend chart.
- [Stacked bar chart](components/charts-stacked-bar.md): A categorical stacked bar chart with accessible values.
- [Sunburst chart](components/charts-sunburst.md): A hierarchical part-to-whole chart with an accessible table.
- [Treemap chart](components/charts-treemap.md): A hierarchical part-to-whole chart with an accessible table.
- [Chat message](components/chat-message.md): One display-only chat message: author, role, time, text and block children.
- [Chat thread](components/chat-thread.md): Read-only conversation transcript of chat-message nodes, without a composer.
- [Choice control](components/control-choice.md): A segmented choice that sets an enum state variable to one of its values.
- [Filter control](components/control-filter.md): A text field that sets a string state variable, capped at its declared length.
- [Slider control](components/control-slider.md): A range input that sets a number state variable within its declared min and max.
- [Toggle control](components/control-toggle.md): A switch that sets a boolean state variable.
- [Board](components/data-board.md): A kanban board: cards in columns (and optional swimlanes), moved by drag, keyboard or a move menu, with work-in-progress limits.
- [Calendar](components/data-calendar.md): Events on a month, week, day or agenda view; people open, and when allowed move, events.
- [Cohort table](components/data-cohort-table.md): A retention table: one row per cohort, one column per period after it started, as rates or counts, with optional heat tints and an averages row.
- [Dashboard](components/data-dashboard.md): A widget grid people can rearrange: data-dashboard-widget children on columns and rows, moved and resized by drag or keyboard, reflowing on narrow screens.
- [Dashboard widget](components/data-dashboard-widget.md): One titled widget of a data-dashboard, placed on the grid; its child is any content node, such as a chart, a KPI or a grid bound to a host data source.
- [File browser](components/data-files.md): Folders and files in a grid or list with breadcrumbs, selection and type previews.
- [Filter builder](components/data-filter-builder.md): Nested and/or groups of conditions (field, operator by field type, value) that people add, edit and remove.
- [Data grid](components/data-grid.md): A sortable, searchable grid of rows and typed columns; virtualized for long lists.
- [Map](components/data-map.md): Places as markers on an offline vector basemap, clustered when close, with a place list beside it.
- [Notification inbox](components/data-notification-inbox.md): Notifications, newest first, with unread state, mark read and unread, mark all read and an unread view.
- [Project timeline](components/data-timeline.md): Tasks as bars over days, weeks, months or quarters, with dependencies and progress.
- [Tree view](components/data-tree-view.md): A hierarchy of items people expand, select and reorder or re-parent by drag or keyboard.
- [Deck slide](components/deck-slide.md): One slide in a deck: a title, content blocks and speaker notes.
- [Document](components/document.md): A block document (a brief, a report, notes or a page) as data: headings, paragraphs, lists, callouts, columns, content blocks and embedded components.
- [Flow action](components/flow-action.md): A button that fires one declared flow event, such as next or back.
- [Flow view](components/flow-view.md): One named view of a multi-step flow; only the current view paints.
- [Form field](components/form-field.md): A named, validated field bound to a declared local-state variable.
- [Form submit](components/form-submit.md): Proposes the form's action with its fields' values; disabled while a receipt is pending.
- [Host region](components/host-region.md): Reserves a named place where the host app mounts its own component.
- [Card layout](components/layout-card.md): Content card frame for grouped agent-authored blocks.
- [Deck layout](components/layout-deck.md): Slide deck frame for sequenced content.
- [Doc layout](components/layout-doc.md): Document frame with optional table of contents.
- [Grid layout](components/layout-grid.md): Responsive content grid for agent-authored tiles.
- [Page layout](components/layout-page.md): Full page content frame for agent-authored documents.
- [Row layout](components/layout-row.md): Children side by side, wrapping onto new lines when space runs out.
- [Split layout](components/layout-split.md): Two panes side by side at a fixed ratio, stacked on narrow screens.
- [Stack layout](components/layout-stack.md): Children in one column, in reading order, with a fixed gap.
- [Grid tile](components/layout-tile.md): A titled tile inside layout-grid that can span several columns or rows.
- [Canvas composition](components/media-composition-canvas.md): A validated layered composition rendered to a canvas.
- [SVG composition](components/media-composition-svg.md): A validated, structured vector composition.
- [Responsive image](components/media-image.md): A responsive image with URL validation, loading states and actions.
- [Schema form](components/schema-form.md): A whole form as data: typed fields in sections or steps, conditional logic, named formats and cross-field rules, painted with texuli controls; submitting proposes one action intent to the host.
- [Sortable list](components/sortable-list.md): A list whose items are a bound list variable; people reorder it by drag or keyboard, and lists sharing a group exchange items.
- [Spreadsheet](components/spreadsheet.md): A spreadsheet as data: tabs of cells holding numbers, text, booleans and formulas that recalculate.
- [Workflow graph](components/workflow-graph.md): A workflow of typed nodes and edges (automations, pipelines, approvals, state diagrams), read-only or editable.

## App and chrome components

Developer-authored UI. Not agent-emittable by default (overlays, forms, display chrome).

- [Alert](components/alert.md): Inline feedback for a page section (status or error).
- [AlertDialog](components/alert-dialog.md): Modal confirm/cancel dialog for consequential actions.
- [AnalyticsGrid](components/analytics-grid.md): Auto-fit KPI and widget grid for dashboard screens.
- [AppNav](components/app-nav.md): Desktop sidebar shell with mobile sheet drawer and main slot.
- [Badge](components/badge.md): A compact status or category label.
- [Banner](components/banner.md): Full-width notice across a page or app shell.
- [Breadcrumb](components/breadcrumb.md): Hierarchy trail with URL-policy links.
- [Button](components/button.md): A pressable action control with loading and optional link rendering.
- [ButtonGroup](components/button-group.md): Groups related buttons with shared borders and orientation.
- [Callout](components/callout.md): Emphasized documentation-style tip with a strong start edge.
- [Card](components/card.md): A surface for grouping related content with optional link behavior.
- [Checkbox](components/checkbox.md): A binary or indeterminate checkbox with optional label.
- [Chip](components/chip.md): A toggleable filter chip (pressed state).
- [Code](components/code.md): Inline or block code with escaped text (no HTML).
- [Combobox](components/combobox.md): A text input that filters a list of options, for one value or several.
- [CommandPalette](components/command-palette.md): Dialog-hosted command palette with search and recent items.
- [ContentLayout](components/content-layout.md): Shared docs/blog/editorial reading frame with optional TOC.
- [ContextMenu](components/context-menu.md): Pointer-anchored menu (right-click, long-press, Menu key).
- [ContextMenu.Trigger](components/context-menu-trigger.md): Region that opens the context menu.
- [Description](components/description.md): Help text associated with a field control.
- [DetailPanel](components/detail-panel.md): Non-modal detail panel alongside content.
- [Dialog](components/dialog.md): Modal dialog with title, optional description, body and footer.
- [Drawer](components/drawer.md): Bottom or edge drawer with optional drag dismiss.
- [DropdownMenu](components/dropdown-menu.md): Menu button pattern with items, checkboxes, radios and submenus.
- [DropdownMenu.Content](components/dropdown-menu-content.md): Floating menu surface for dropdown items.
- [DropdownMenu.Item](components/dropdown-menu-item.md): Menu item with optional icon and shortcut chrome.
- [DropdownMenu.Trigger](components/dropdown-menu-trigger.md): Styled button that opens a dropdown menu.
- [Empty state](components/empty-state.md): Placeholder when a list or panel has nothing to show yet.
- [Error state](components/error-state.md): Full-panel failure with optional retry.
- [Field](components/field.md): Label, description and error wiring for a single control.
- [FieldError](components/field-error.md): An alert-role error message for a field.
- [Form](components/form.md): A form shell with layout, validation hook and error map.
- [HoverCard](components/hover-card.md): Preview panel that opens on hover or focus.
- [HoverCard.Content](components/hover-card-content.md): Styled hover-card surface.
- [IconButton](components/icon-button.md): An icon-only button that requires an accessible name.
- [Inline text](components/inline-text.md): A plain text run for the slot of a slot-only component (button, label, badge).
- [Input](components/input.md): A single-line text (or file) control with optional clear.
- [InputGroup](components/input-group.md): An input with start/end adornments and optional clear.
- [Kbd](components/kbd.md): Inline keyboard key affordance.
- [KPI](components/kpi.md): A formatted metric with unit, previous-period delta and optional link.
- [Label](components/label.md): A form label with optional required marker and sr-only mode.
- [Auth split layout](components/layout-auth-split.md): Sign-in form column plus brand panel.
- [Blog layout](components/layout-blog.md): Blog/post reading layout (content-layout kind blog).
- [LayoutChrome](components/layout-chrome.md): Shared brand, actions, user and skip-link chrome for desktop layouts.
- [Dashboard grid layout](components/layout-dashboard-grid.md): Top chrome plus container-query widget grid.
- [Docs layout](components/layout-docs.md): Documentation reading layout (content-layout kind docs).
- [LayoutDrawer](components/layout-drawer.md): Mobile navigation drawer built on the dialog primitive.
- [Dual sidebar layout](components/layout-dual-sidebar.md): Primary nav plus optional context aside.
- [Editorial layout](components/layout-editorial.md): Long-read editorial layout (content-layout kind editorial).
- [LayoutHost](components/layout-host.md): Resolves a layout id, applies width fallbacks, and keeps one stable screen outlet.
- [Landing layout](components/layout-landing.md): Standalone marketing landing composition.
- [Marketing layout](components/layout-marketing.md): Marketing page frame with hero, sections and footer slots.
- [Pricing layout](components/layout-pricing.md): Pricing plans grid with title and footnote.
- [Settings layout](components/layout-settings.md): Settings section list plus detail pane.
- [Sidebar layout](components/layout-sidebar.md): App sidebar column with responsive drawer fallback.
- [Top navigation layout](components/layout-top-nav.md): Horizontal top navigation with optional mobile menu.
- [Wizard layout](components/layout-wizard.md): Centered onboarding wizard frame with steps.
- [Menubar](components/menubar.md): Application menubar with roving top-level items.
- [Menubar.Trigger](components/menubar-trigger.md): Top-level menubar item that opens a menu.
- [MultiSelect](components/multi-select.md): A combobox for several values, shown as removable chips.
- [NavIcon](components/nav-icon.md): Renders a nav model icon by name or component.
- [NavigationMenu](components/navigation-menu.md): Site or app navigation with expandable triggers and links.
- [Pagination](components/pagination.md): Page controls for long lists.
- [Popover](components/popover.md): Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger.
- [Popover.Content](components/popover-content.md): Styled popover surface with optional arrow.
- [Radio](components/radio.md): One option inside a RadioGroup.
- [RadioGroup](components/radio-group.md): A set of exclusive radio options with keyboard roving.
- [ResponsiveModal](components/responsive-modal.md): Dialog on large screens, drawer/sheet on small screens.
- [ScreenOutlet](components/screen-outlet.md): Stable screen mount point that survives layout switches.
- [Select](components/select.md): A single-value select root with size and variant chrome.
- [Select.Content](components/select-content.md): The positioned listbox surface for Select items.
- [Select.Group](components/select-group.md): Groups related Select items under an optional label.
- [Select.Item](components/select-item.md): One selectable option inside Select.Content.
- [Select.Label](components/select-label.md): A non-interactive heading inside a Select group.
- [Select.Portal](components/select-portal.md): Portals Select.Content out of overflow-clipped ancestors.
- [Select.Separator](components/select-separator.md): A visual divider between Select groups or items.
- [Select.Trigger](components/select-trigger.md): The button that opens a Select listbox.
- [Select.Value](components/select-value.md): Shows the selected label or a placeholder inside the trigger.
- [Select.Viewport](components/select-viewport.md): Scrollable viewport inside Select.Content.
- [Sheet](components/sheet.md): Edge-anchored modal panel (drawer-like sheet).
- [Sidebar](components/sidebar.md): Collapsible app rail with sections, badges and safe links.
- [SplitView](components/split-view.md): Master-detail split with list and detail panes.
- [Stat](components/stat.md): A single metric with optional delta, trend and sparkline slot.
- [Stepper](components/stepper.md): Horizontal or vertical progress through ordered steps.
- [Switch](components/switch.md): An immediate on/off setting control.
- [Table](components/table.md): A responsive data table with density, stacking and sticky header options.
- [Tag](components/tag.md): A labeled chip that can be removed.
- [TextCounter](components/text-counter.md): An input or textarea that shows remaining characters near the limit.
- [Textarea](components/textarea.md): A multi-line text control with optional autosize.
- [TimeField](components/time-field.md): A labelled time of day typed or stepped by segment (hour, minute, AM/PM), with a 24-hour HH:mm value.
- [Timeline](components/timeline.md): Vertical or horizontal chronological list of events.
- [Toaster](components/toaster.md): Live region that renders toast notifications from the shared store.
- [Tooltip](components/tooltip.md): Short delayed hint on hover or focus.
